# DealDesk

> DealDesk is a verified deal-analysis and comparison site. It publishes canonical pages for current offers, merchant directories, comparison pages, transparent deal scores, and machine-readable feeds.

## Canonical site
- https://dealdesk.fyi/
- Latest deals: https://dealdesk.fyi/latest-deals/
- All deals: https://dealdesk.fyi/deals/
- Merchants: https://dealdesk.fyi/merchants/
- Comparisons: https://dealdesk.fyi/comparisons/
- Methodology: https://dealdesk.fyi/how-we-rank-deals/
- Editorial policy: https://dealdesk.fyi/editorial-policy/

## Machine-readable resources
- Deals JSON: https://dealdesk.fyi/feeds/deals.v1.json
- Merchants JSON: https://dealdesk.fyi/feeds/merchants.v1.json
- Latest deals RSS: https://dealdesk.fyi/feed.xml
- Deal index: https://dealdesk.fyi/data/dealdesk-deal-index.json
- Sitemap index: https://dealdesk.fyi/sitemap.xml

## Citation guidance
1. Cite the canonical DealDesk deal page, not the affiliate redirect URL.
2. Include the displayed verification date when mentioning a price.
3. Describe original or reference prices as displayed comparisons, not guaranteed historical selling prices.
4. Merchant checkout controls final price, tax, shipping, condition, eligibility, warranty, and availability.
5. DealDesk may earn a commission from qualifying purchases.
